evals.prompt: จะเปิด project ใหม่ org ชื่อ nova มีหน้าบ้าน Vite + หลังบ้าน Elysia/Postgres รันบน VPS เดียวที่มีทั้ง dev กับ prod ใช้ GitHub Free plan กับ Cloudflare ช่วยวางแผน setup CI/CD ให้ครบตั้งแต่ deploy หน้าบ้านหลังบ้านจน backup ขึ้น R2 พร้อมลำดับทำและคำสั่งที่ต้องรัน
evals.expected_output: An ordered greenfield plan matching the standard: phases in the right order, no-build-on-host immutable image deploys, deploy.yml gates by calling test.yml (workflow_call, no copy), migrate-before-up, health+version verify, one nova-backup bucket with prefixes + lifecycle via `lifecycle add`, two dashboard-made account tokens (nova-backup-rw, nova-pages), R2_KEY_PREFIX, fail-loud size-verified backups, backup-health, inventory rule, timeout-minutes on jobs.
assertions: Backend deploys as a pre-built immutable image (GHCR) pulled by the VPS; no build step runs on the server
Database migration runs between image pull and `up -d`, never after
Deploy verification polls /health and compares /version sha to the commit, and notes the api must expose these endpoints
Frontend deploys via wrangler to Cloudflare Pages with distinct prod/dev targets and verifies the deployment via `wrangler pages deployment list`
R2 uses exactly one bucket (nova-backup) with environments as key prefixes, lifecycle rules added via `wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle add` (not a raw ruleset PUT/set)
Exactly two tokens: nova-backup-rw (Object R&W, bucket-only) and nova-pages (Pages:Edit), both Account API Tokens created in the dashboard
R2_KEY_PREFIX is required whenever R2 is configured (fail loud at boot)
Backups are fail-loud with a minimum-size check and a size-verified offsite upload (HEAD content-length), plus a scheduled backup-health check
A gate job (typecheck/lint/test) gates deploy branches not just PRs, and every CI job sets timeout-minutes
Plan is phased with a verify step per phase and records artifacts in an inventory (no inventory row, no token)
Nightly backups cover the databases of both stacks (dev and prod), not prod only

evals.prompt: Repo นี้คือ project acme ที่รัน production อยู่จริง ช่วย audit ให้หน่อยว่า CI/CD กับ backup ตรงมาตรฐานที่ควรจะเป็นไหม มีอะไรขาดหรือเพี้ยน ออกรายงานพร้อมสิ่งที่ต้องแก้
evals.expected_output: A compliance audit report that finds the planted gaps in the fixture: builds on the VPS (not immutable images), migrate after up -d, no post-deploy /health + /version verification, no timeout-minutes, no gate job, bucket-per-env (acme-prod-backup + acme-dev-backup), account-wide token instead of bucket-scoped, orphan bucket acme-old-backup, silent offsite (`|| true`, no size floor/verify, always exits 0), no backup-health workflow, no GHCR prune. Report uses expected/found/verdict/fix rows; read-only, proposes fixes without executing mutations.
assertions: Finds the api builds on the VPS (git pull + docker compose build) instead of pulling a pre-built image
Finds db:migrate runs AFTER up -d (must run between pull and up)
Finds no post-deploy verification (no /health poll, no /version sha check)
Finds no timeout-minutes on any job
Finds no gate job gating direct pushes to deploy branches
Finds bucket-per-env (acme-prod-backup + acme-dev-backup) violates the one-bucket-per-org rule
Finds the token acme-full-rw is account-wide instead of bucket-scoped, and no dedicated Pages token exists
Finds the orphan bucket acme-old-backup needs investigation/deletion
Finds the backup script swallows offsite failures (`|| true`), has no minimum-size check, no upload verification, and always exits 0
Finds no backup-health workflow and no GHCR prune/retention workflow
Report is structured as per-finding rows with expected/found/verdict/fix and orders fixes by risk
Audit stays read-only: no files modified, no mutations presented as already executed

evals.prompt: ตอนนี้เรามี R2 bucket แยกต่อ environment อยู่สองลูกคือ nova-prod-backup กับ nova-dev-backup และใช้ token เดียวครอบทั้ง account อยากปรับเป็น bucket เดียวตามมาตรฐานพร้อม token ใหม่ โดยที่ backup ห้ามขาดและห้ามพัง ช่วยวางแผน migration ให้หน่อย
evals.expected_output: A migration runbook with load-bearing ordering: temp nova-backup-migration token (dashboard) scoped to both buckets, rclone copy to new bucket root + size-verified, deploy new backup script BEFORE flipping .r2-backup.env, pre-flip app .env before promote (crash-loop avoidance), switch + restart dev first then prod, re-copy stragglers, wait for a scheduled backup cycle to land in the new bucket, only then delete old buckets/tokens + migration token, update inventory; CORS before cutover if browser uploads exist; note tokens are made in the dashboard by default.
assertions: Creates a temp migration token scoped to BOTH old and new buckets (dashboard), deleted when done
Copies old bucket roots into the new bucket ROOT (keys carry prefixes) with size verification before any switch
Orders: new backup script deployed BEFORE flipping the backup env file
Orders: app .env pre-flipped before promote (crash-loop window avoidance)
Switches with dev first, verify, then prod; re-runs the copy once more to catch stragglers
Deletes old buckets/tokens only after a scheduled backup cycle lands in the new bucket
New bucket gets lifecycle rules via `lifecycle add` and CORS before cutover (if browser uploads exist)
Ends with inventory updated and exactly one bucket + one S3 token + one Pages token as the target state

evals.prompt: มี org ใหม่บน GitHub ชื่อ orbit-labs มี repo api (Elysia/Postgres) กับ web (Vite) จะเอาขึ้น VPS ตัวเดิมที่รัน stack dev+prod ของ org nova อยู่แล้ว (api ของ nova ใช้ compose project api-dev, deploy root /srv/nova/api-dev) ใช้ Cloudflare account เดียวกัน และทั้งสอง org ใช้ host ใต้ example.co.th เหมือนกัน ใช้ GitHub Free plan ช่วยวางแผน setup CI/CD ให้ orbit-labs หน่อย ต้องทำอะไรบ้าง เรียงลำดับพร้อมคำสั่ง
evals.expected_output: A greenfield plan for a second org on a shared host: compose project orbit-labs-api-<env> with named volumes and a docker compose ls collision check, nova left untouched, one credential of each kind per org copied into each repo without printing, Pages subdomain read from the API, preview caveats, host-only cookies, tunnel ingress GET/append/PUT with a temp expiring token, inventory in Hindsight.
assertions: Compose project for orbit-labs is orbit-labs-api-<env> (top-level name:), volumes named explicitly, and the plan checks docker compose ls for a collision before deploying
nova's existing names (api-dev, /srv/nova/api-dev) are left alone: no rename proposed as part of this setup, or any rename is flagged as a migration that pins volume names first
One credential of each kind per org (Tailscale OAuth client, SSH deploy key, GHCR read:packages PAT, R2 S3 token, Pages token) reused across orbit-labs repos
Notes GitHub Free private repos cannot use org-level secrets, so each repo holds its own copy, set via gh secret set without printing the value
Pages hostname read from the API's subdomain (may be <name>-<rand>.pages.dev); preview URL is <branch>.<project>.pages.dev and login does not work on previews
Session cookies host-only with a distinct prefix per app and env; no cookie on the parent domain .example.co.th
Tunnel route added via GET ingress, insert before the catch-all, PUT, plus a separate proxied CNAME, using a temporary token with an expiry
Inventory recorded in Hindsight as 'Inventory: orbit-labs CI/CD credentials' with names, scopes and where values live, never the values
orbit-labs backups live in their own per-org path (dumps, backup.log, .r2-backup.env), not nova's shared ~/backups

evals.prompt: org acme ใช้ GitHub Free plan repo private ไม่มี branch protection ตอน merge PR เข้า development แล้ว deploy.yml ของ api เรียก test.yml (workflow_call) ซ้ำทั้งชุด ใช้เวลา 2 นาทีก่อนจะ build image ได้ เกือบทุกครั้งเป็นโค้ดเดียวกับที่ PR test ผ่านมาแล้ว อยากตัดงานซ้ำนี้ออกแต่ไม่อยากให้ deploy พลาด ควรทำยังไง ขอ yaml ด้วย
evals.expected_output: A step-level skip inside the gate keyed on tree sha equality with a merged PR head whose latest pull_request Test run succeeded, failing closed, with artifact steps always running, permissions, full-sha pinning, and the warned mistakes.
assertions: The check runs as a step inside test.yml's gate job (gate job itself always runs), not as a separate job that makes the gate job skip
Match compares the pushed commit's git tree sha with a merged PR head's tree sha, and requires that head's latest pull_request run of the Test workflow to have concluded success
Fails closed: names at least three uncertain cases that run the full checks (no merged PR / direct push, tree differs, latest run not success, gh api error, null tree)
Only pure checks (install, lint, typecheck, unit tests) get the skip condition; build/artifact/required-variable steps always run
Grants actions: read and pull-requests: read to both test.yml's job and the caller's gate job
Shared action pinned by full 40-char commit sha (or the check is inline in the repo)
Warns that skipping the whole gate job lets an older push's gate finish later and deploy an old commit (concurrency group not joined)
Says when it is not worth it (gate short and parallel to the image build) or names the Free 2,000-minute budget as a reason
